name: What are the legal requirements for landlord maintenance responsibilities in California?

mainEntity.name: What are the legal requirements for landlord maintenance responsibilities in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: In California, landlords are legally required to maintain their rental properties in a habitable condition, meaning they must ensure the property is safe and fit to live in. This includes providing effective waterproofing, working plumbing and gas facilities, hot and cold running water, proper heating, safe electrical wiring, and keeping the premises clean and free from pests. Failure to meet these standards can lead to legal consequences. Tenants must also maintain their units and report issues promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: California landlords must maintain properties in habitable condition, providing safe plumbing, electricity, heating, and sanitation. Failure to comply can have legal repercussions.
